descriptor.color: OpenCV uint8 HSV/Lab; channel L1; hue weighted S/255 and circular smoothing [1,2,1]/4; H [0,180), S/V/a/b [0,256)
descriptor.direction: stored input orientation; requirement4 must compare original and horizontal flip queries through same frozen pipeline, min distance for every label; retrieval not implemented

gabor.design_resolution: 12 filters x 2 statistics was 24, not 48; two fixed bandwidths resolve design ambiguity
gabor.kernel: complex Gaussian exp(-r²/(2sigma²)+2pi*i*f*x_rot)/(2pi*sigma²); rotated bounding rectangle at n_stds=2; no DC subtraction
gabor.measurement: gray/255; full rectangular support must be foreground; magnitude mean/population std

descriptor.glcm: gray_uint8//4; d1,3; angles0,45,90,135; dy=round(d*sin),dx=round(d*cos); both endpoints in mask; symmetric L1; energy=sqrt(ASM); contrast=sum(p*(i-j)^2); homogeneity=sum(p/(1+(i-j)^2)); correlation variance<=1e-15 is undefined
descriptor.lbp: P8 uniform rotation invariant; R1,R3; bilinear circular samples, neighbor>=center; all contributing interpolation pixels in foreground; <=2 transitions maps to popcount, else bin9
descriptor.missing: empty histogram/texture support/profile or undefined denominator -> raw0, validity=false, explicit reason outside vector; valid observations alone fit scaler; transformed missing=0; empty/full source mask, shape mismatch, nonbinary or nonfinite -> fail without vector
descriptor.name: b400_v1

normalization.concatenate: each subblock L2, concatenate subblocks then group L2; each group times sqrt(weight); final L2; zero norms remain zero
normalization.continuous: per-coordinate population zscore using valid development observations; std<=1e-12 ->1; no clipping
normalization.fit_scope: all successful current images as development corpus, no labels; not a held-out evaluation
normalization.histogram: sqrt per-channel L1 (already L1 in raw)

descriptor.resize: bbox all components; uniform scale min(288/w,192/h), round sizes; centered; nearest mask; RGB masked normalized INTER_LINEAR, uint8 round; nearest RGB fallback if alpha0; no background interpolation

s2e.coordinates: integer pixel centers (x=column,y=row), origin top-left, y down; pixel units; no +1
s2e.degenerate: fewer than two distinct points or zero perpendicular span -> raw0,validity=false
s2e.measurement: source mask before resize; convex hull of all foreground pixel centers; major=max Euclidean pair distance; minor=full contour projection span perpendicular to major; axis_ratio=major/minor; no PCA
s2e.ties: sort endpoints within pair lexicographically by (x,y); choose lexicographically smallest pair among exact integer squared-distance maxima

s3.provenance: canvas/grid chosen by team to retain 48 dimensions, not specified by lecture
s3.raw: 48 bits; occupancy before threshold in metadata
s3.resize: bbox all foreground; uniform scale min(256/w,192/h); round sizes (ties to even), min1; center with floor offsets; zero padding; INTER_NEAREST; no rotation

descriptor.shape: Hu binary canvas all components, signed log floor1e-12, zero->zero; aspect original bbox; extent/solidity/circularity canvas; A=pixel count; hull=raster filled convex hull of all pixel centers; P=exposed pixel edges including holes; profiles32 x-strips upper=min_y/H,lower=(max_y+1)/H

rules.concatenate: each subblock L2, concatenate subblocks then group L2; each group times sqrt(weight); final L2; zero norms remain zero
rules.continuous: per-coordinate population zscore using valid development observations; std<=1e-12 ->1; no clipping
rules.fit_scope: all successful current images as development corpus, no labels; not a held-out evaluation
rules.histogram: sqrt per-channel L1 (already L1 in raw)

search_policies.orientation: min(original, flipped); original wins exact orientation ties
search_policies.duplicates: all eligible files ranked independently, including identical SHA-256
search_policies.validity: fixed normalized vector, no pair-specific validity reweighting
